However, the query does not specify which policy is being referred to — there is no identifying information such as a policy number, name of the insured, or issuing company. Without this context, it is impossible to determine which policy is meant, and therefore impossible to retrieve the face amount.

This is not a multi-hop query because there is no chain of reasoning or intermediate facts to resolve — the issue is simply a lack of necessary identifying details. The query cannot be answered as-is due to ambiguity.

Therefore, the only sub-goal is to clarify which policy is being referred to, as the face amount cannot be determined without that information.
